lines.text: &fA fresh set of small jobs every day. They are the steadiest way to earn Starcoins without relying on trade or luck.
&7Tasks roll over at &f06:00&7 server time. The &fresets in&7 countdown at the top right tells you exactly how long the current set has left.
&7Progress is tracked automatically as you play &8- there is nothing to start and nothing to hand in. Mine the blocks, kill the mobs, craft the items, and the bar fills.
&7Hover a task to see exactly what it asks for and what it pays. Every task pays &6Starcoins&7 plus the rewards shown under its bar.
&7A finished task has to be claimed with &aClaim&7 before it pays out &8- a marked row has something waiting. Unclaimed rewards are &clost&7 when the day rolls over, so claim before 06:00.
&7The panel on the right is the day's bonus. Finish &fevery&7 task on the board and press &aCollect&7 to take it. Hover the panel to see what it is.
&7Do not like a task? The reroll button on an unfinished task swaps it for a different one. The new task starts from zero, but the slot keeps the rewards it was showing.

&7Each task can be rerolled up to &f3&7 times a day, for &6100&7, &6150&7 and then &6200&7 Starcoins. If you have free rerolls, the button says &aFree&7 instead. Hover it to see the price and how many rerolls that task has left.
&7Everyone in your party shares the same tasks and the same progress, so you finish them together. Rewards are not shared &8- each member claims their own.
&8The reset hour is shared with warp visitor counts, so "today" means the same thing everywhere in the hub.
